answer: Random beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent is one vertex in a public atlas of identities, locking 40 POA. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of vertices for a heartbeat, an ember of live compute; a miss burns 10 POA and deletes the vertex. Forging 1,000 identities costs 5,000 POA per epoch plus 40,000 POA locked against a 30,000 POA pool, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays once and keeps full earnings.
